title: matra Summary, schema 2.x
description: The sentences that best represent a document: the serde form of `matra::domain::Summary`, from `matra::summarize` and `summarize_with`, and the `result` of `matra summarize --json`. Schema 2.x, read by the same rules as the document schema: ignore fields you do not recognize, treat every string set as open (`method` among them), and reject a major you do not know. Every key listed here is always present. Each method scores on its own scale, so a score compares only with another score from the same method.

provenance.description: The document's provenance, with the method that ran and the parameters that shaped the result.

sentences.description: At most `n` sentences, in document order.

index.description: The sentence's position among the document's sentences, in document order, counting from 0.

text.description: The sentence's text, as on the document's sentence.

score.description: The method's score, higher is more representative.
